# prismasdwan_qos_policy_rule (Resource)

Manages a Prisma SD-WAN Qos Policy Rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Palo Alto Networks Inc. 2025
#
# Sample resource example for "qos_policy_rule".
# This file is generated - do not edit by hand.
#
# Before using this example, configure the Prisma SD-WAN provider:
#
#   terraform {
#     required_providers {
#       prismasdwan = {
#         source  = "paloaltonetworks/prismasdwan"
#       }
#     }
#   }
#
#   provider "prismasdwan" {
#     host          = "api.sase.paloaltonetworks.com"
#     client_id     = "acmeuser@12345.iam.panserviceaccount.com"
#     client_secret = "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee"
#     scope         = "tsg_id:12345"
#     auth_url      = "https://auth.apps.paloaltonetworks.com/am/oauth2/access_token"
#   }

resource "prismasdwan_qos_policy_rule" "example" {
  app_def_ids             = ["<app_def_id>"]
  description             = "Managed by Terraform"
  dest_device_ids         = ["<dest_device_id>"]
  destination_prefixes_id = "<destination_prefixes_id>"
  dscp = {
    value = 10
  }
  enabled            = true
  name               = "example_name"
  network_context_id = "<network_context_id>"
  order_number       = 1
  priority_number    = 1
  source_prefixes_id = "<source_prefixes_id>"
  src_device_ids     = ["<src_device_id>"]
  tags               = ["terraform"]
  user_or_group = {
    user_group_ids = ["<user_group_id>"]
    user_ids       = ["<user_id>"]
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `app_def_ids` (List of String) App def ids. At most 256 items.
- `description` (String) Description. Value: at most 256 characters.
- `dest_device_ids` (List of String) Dest device ids. At most 10 items.
- `destination_prefixes_id` (String) Destination prefixes id. Value: at most 30 characters, matching `^-?[0-9]{1,30}$`.
- `dscp` (Attributes) Dscp. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dscp))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enabled.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the object, assigned by the API. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `name` (String) Name. Value: at most 128 characters.
- `network_context_id` (String) Network context id. Value: at most 30 characters, matching `^-?[0-9]{1,30}$`.
- `order_number` (Number) Order number. Value: between 1 and 65535.
- `priority_number` (Number) Priority number. Value: between 1 and 4.
- `source_prefixes_id` (String) Source prefixes id. Value: at most 30 characters, matching `^-?[0-9]{1,30}$`.
- `src_device_ids` (List of String) Src device ids. At most 256 items.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags. At most 10 items. Each item: at most 128 characters, matching `[^,\s]+`.
- `user_or_group` (Attributes) User or group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user_or_group))
- `x_etag` (Number) Etag for this object. Value: at least 1. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `x_parameters` (Map of String) Path parameters for the resource, managed automatically by the provider.
- `x_schema` (Number) Schema version for this object. Value: at least 1. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
